signInIntro: Enter the details held against your name. Public inspection remains open without an account.
signUpIntro: Enter your particulars to establish a personal account. Public inspection requires no registration.
passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number, and a special character.
accountIntro: Your current account is on file below.
invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
locked: This account is temporarily locked. Try again later.
rate_limit_exceeded: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
validation_failed: Check the supplied details and try again.
username_taken: This username is already in use.
email_taken: This email is already in use.
unavailable: Access is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
serviceBody: The personal access register could not be reached. Your session has not been cleared. Public inspection remains available.
usernameHint: 3–20 letters (A–Z), numbers, or underscores. Usernames are case-insensitive; reserved and offensive names are not accepted.
nameUnavailable: The name register is unavailable. A name will be assigned when you register. You may also try again.
identityHint: Your public analyst name is drawn from the registry. Reroll before filing to choose another. Your registry number and archive address are assigned on registration.
registryHeading: Every name has a place in the archive.
registryStatement: The public record is open to all. A personal account establishes your place among those who contribute to it.
publicReadingNote: Browse incidents, read records, and follow explorations without registering.
personalRecordNote: Keep your credentials private. The archive assigns a separate analyst identity for public display.
credentialNote: Your real email is private. Your archive address is a display identity, not a mailbox.
accountIndexIntro: The particulars held against your name. Consult each section of your personal record below.
identityDetails: Your public identity in the archive. The archive address is for display only; it does not receive mail.
sessionDetails: You are signed in to this browser. Sign out to close this session; public records remain available.
cookieBody: We use necessary cookies to keep you signed in and remember your language. We do not currently set optional analytics or advertising cookies. Public reading remains available without signing in.
cookieInventory: circa_at and circa_rt are HttpOnly authentication cookies. NEXT_LOCALE remembers your language. circa_cookie_notice remembers this notice for one year.
